verdict.rationale: Ramp's multi-entity page says one consolidated account can run separate spend policies and controls for each entity. It also syncs transaction and reimbursement data to multiple entities in a single step, which implies per-entity books in connected ERPs, and entities are exposed as a readable object via MCP. Multi-currency is evidenced only for employee reimbursements (40 currencies), and consolidated cross-entity reporting is not shown. Missing for 10: explicit consolidated cross-entity reporting, multi-currency support for cards, bills and entity books, detail on per-entity ledger and GL mapping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
